subject: general
question: The “Framework for the U.S.–India Major Defence Partnership”, recently in the news, primarily aims to:

options.text: Establish a 10-year roadmap to enhance bilateral cooperation in the defence industry and technology.
Create a trilateral defence alliance between India, the U.S., and Japan under the Quad framework.
Replace the foundational defence agreements (LEMOA, COMCASA, BECA) with a new strategic pact.
Develop a joint military command structure for operations in the Indo-Pacific region.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India and the United States signed a 10-year defence partnership framework on the sidelines of the 12th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus) in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The framework aims to strengthen the U.S.–India Major Defence Partnership, enhancing cooperation in defence industry, technology, and innovation. **Hence, Option A is correct. **
 
• It outlines a strategic roadmap for the next decade, reaffirming both nations’ commitment to defence collaboration and regional stability in the Indo-Pacific.
 
• It does not establish a trilateral alliance.** Hence, Option B is incorrect. **
 
• It is complementary to existing agreements like LEMOA, COMCASA, and BECA, not a replacement. **Hence, Option C is incorrect. **
 
• No joint command structure was proposed. **Hence, Option D is incorrect.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The agreement was signed by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth.
 
• Both sides reaffirmed that defence remains a major pillar of bilateral relations, crucial for maintaining a free, open, and rules-based Indo-Pacific region.
